name: @hheei/omp-mctx
description: OMP Window owner: Magic Context compaction, compartments, ctx_reduce/expand/note; legacy Durable Memory is opt-in.

scripts.test: bun test src/host src/core/shared/data-path.ts src/core/features/fresh-schema.test.ts src/core/features/fail-closed-block.test.ts src/core/features/memory/embedding-local.test.ts src/core/features/memory/embedding-openai-failure.test.ts src/core/hooks/empty-task-output.test.ts src/core/hooks/temporal-awareness.test.ts src/core/hooks/strip-content.test.ts src/core/hooks/format-embed-failure.test.ts src/core/agents/magic-context-prompt.test.ts src/commands/ctx-embed-partial.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/core/hooks/lkg-persist.test.ts src/core/hooks/raw-fallback-context-limit.test.ts src/lkg-pi.test.ts

enabled.description: Leave off on the daily OMP until Durable Memory is unregistered (ADR-0001).

memoryEnabled.description: Opt in to omp-mctx's legacy durable-memory store. Keep false when @hheei/omp-agentmemory owns Durable Memory.

searchEnabled.description: Register ctx_search for session-history retrieval. Disable to remove it from the agent tool surface.

noteEnabled.description: Register ctx_note and session-note nudges. Disable to remove both.

historianEnabled.description: Allow historian compaction runs when historianModel is configured.

historianModel.description: Provider/model ID used for historian compaction, for example lmxu/gpt-5.6-sol:high. Empty keeps historian inactive.
